Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

getGuardians().details: WARNING: This operation will copy the entire storage to memory, which can be quite expensive. This is designed to mostly be used by view accessors that are queried without any gas fees.

getPools().details: WARNING: This operation will copy the entire storage to memory, which can be quite expensive. This is designed to mostly be used by view accessors that are queried without any gas fees.

isGuardian(address).details: Check if the sender is an authorized guardian

open().details: Open contract operations, if contract is in shutdown state

pause().details: Suspend deposit feature, if contract is not paused.

shutdown().details: Suspend all features (issue, repay, deposit, withdraw, liquidate and swap), if not already shutdown.

transferGovernorship(address).details: Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Unpause contract operations, allow only if contract is paused and not shutdown.

DestinationChainIsActiveUpdated(uint16,b.notice: Emitted when flag for support chain is toggled

FeeCollectorUpdated(address,address).notice: Emitted when fee collector is updated

GuardianAdded(address).notice: Emitted when a guardian is added

GuardianRemoved(address).notice: Emitted when a guardian is removed

LzBaseGasLimitUpdated(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when Lz base gas limit updated

MasterOracleUpdated(address,address).notice: Emitted when master oracle contract is updated

NativeTokenGatewayUpdated(address,addres.notice: Emitted when native token gateway is updated

Open(address).notice: Emitted when contract is turned on

OperatorUpdated(address,address).notice: Emitted when Operator contract is updated

PoolRegistered(uint256,address).notice: Emitted when a pool is registered

SwapperUpdated(address,address).notice: Emitted when Swapper contract is updated

acceptGovernorship().notice: Allows new governor to accept governorship of the contract.

idOfPool(address).notice: Map of the ids of the pools
